name: Kakegawa Yuri
source:
A married woman who lives in the room next to the main character's apartment. Her husband is on a single assignment. Her job is Merakawa Yuzu's manager.
She comes home only occasionally. 

"Well..., you've become a lot of "adults", haven't you?"
